title.narrative: Greater Mekong Subregion Ben Luc-Long Thanh Expressway Project - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The Project constructs a 57.1 km expressway between Ben Luc and Long Thanh in the south of Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), which is a short link of the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS) Southern Economic Corridor. The project expressway is divided into a western section (21.14 km), a middle section (10.71 km), and an eastern section (25.25 km). For the expressway construction, ADB finances the western and eastern sections, and Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) finances the middle section. The project was estimated to cost $1.608 billion at appraisal, inclusive of local taxes, contingencies, and financing charges during development. Tranche 2 in the amount of $286 million will cover construction of the eastern section of the expressway.

Output: Road density of HCMC increased and connection between east and west regions of HCMC enhanced. Indicator: Construction of eastern section expressway (25.25 km) completed by 2023 (2015 baseline: 0 km) Achievement: 3.5 Progress/Status: All 3 eastern section civil works contracts (A5, A6, and A7) were awarded on 25 September 2017, of which contract A5 has been completed and contract A7 is expected to complete by Q2 2024.
The A6 contract was terminated following the contractor's notification in November 2020, the Employer's notification in February 2022 and ADB's no-objection in June 2022. The A6 contract's remaining scope plus some additional items due to design adjustments were rebidded in 5 packages, using national competitive bidding method. All the five packages have been commenced and estimated to be completed by Q2 2024.
Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of the project supervision consultant
